name: Bloodtide: Classic [1.285]
desc:
[WARNING: Photosensitive Content, Jumpscares, Loud Sounds]
[CLASSIC: The original Bloodtide you know and love, slightly "butchered" to comply with ToS]

Your entire town has been sealed off from the rest of the world.
Between the endless fighting, shouts, and rising tension, you're being worn thin.
Now you're seeing things you shouldn't. Something is deeply wrong. It's time to prepare.

A fast-paced arcade shooter with light horror elements.
Play in your server region for better latency.

🔫 Choose your weapons and items from the selection menu!
🎮 Controls and credits are available in the settings menu.
👍 Don't forget to like and favorite!

📝 v1.29 - Small Patch
- Kill Milestone Badges
- Bug fixes and more

⚠️ Exploiting with external programs or abusing bugs/glitches in ways that ruin the experience for others will result in a ban.
